purpose: MP-2 S0 descriptive probe (PLAN.md 3.3): Tune v1 analysis-MC truth vs NuWro 21.09 truth; sizes S2. Not a production reweighter; no J cell and no hybrid null is read.

population.phase_space: analysis truth phase space: pT in [0, 4.5], p_par in [1.5, 60] GeV/c, theta_mu < 20 deg (u2d.in_truth_phase_space), and inside the s5p fine 5D grid (edges of of_inputs_5d.npz; histogramdd convention)
population.enu_note: NuWro's generation range (gen5d_flux_reweight GEN_RANGE['nuwro']); the 50-100 GeV NuWro supplement is not used, so Tune v1 is cut to the same range
population.tune_v1: of_inputs_5d rows with pass_truth, from the S1 dump; HYDROGEN EXCLUDED (mc_targetZ == 1 dropped) because NuWro is on C12 only

tune_v1_subsample.rule: uniform without replacement over eligible rows

population.nuwro: work_nuwro_p1..p8 treeout (post arrays) row-aligned to gen5d/nuwro_flat5d_p1..p8; cc == 1; extract_nuwro's phase-space mask; all eligible events used

weights.nuwro: e.weight x r(E_nu), r from gen5d_flux_reweight.flux_weights/r_of with gen5d_fluxfix/phi_t.npz and flux_mefhc_numu_nuwro.root:flux_numu on [0.5, 50] GeV

frames.tune_v1: mc_FSPart momenta rotated into the MAT beam frame, RotateX(-0.05887)

particle_harmonization.excluded: |pdg| == 13 (the muon; its kinematics enter through pT, p_par), |pdg| in {11, 12, 14, 16}, pdg >= 1000000000 (nuclear remnants/fragments) and pdg >= 2000000000 (GENIE pseudo-particles)

other.pdg: anything not excluded and not above (kaons, hyperons, eta, antinucleons, ...)

features.leading: highest KE (E for pi0) above threshold; cos is the polar-angle cosine in the beam frame; NaN when absent (LightGBM missing)
features.scalar_conventions: each sample's own frozen-product convention: Tune v1 = MCgen columns; NuWro = nuwro_flat5d pt, pz, eavail, q3, W (NuWro W uses M_n and a W = 0 clamp, MP-5 (b))

fits.class_balance: training, validation and test weights normalised so each class sums to half that split's row count (mean weight 1; keeps min_sum_hessian_in_leaf meaningful)

readouts.auc: weighted ROC AUC on test (sklearn roc_auc_score, class-balanced weights)
readouts.w: w = p/(1-p) on the Tune v1 test rows, normalised so sum(w_truth * w) = sum(w_truth)
readouts.kish: ESS = (sum v)^2 / sum v^2 with v = w_truth * w; reported / N and / ESS(w_truth)
readouts.logw_within_cell: w_truth-weighted variance of log w within each fine 5D cell (cells with >= 20 test rows), pooled by cell w_truth; and the total variance
readouts.timing: wall seconds of each fit and prediction; best iteration
